title: Why Cats Knock Things Over

scenes.narration: Every cat owner knows the moment. A cup sits peacefully on the edge of a table. And a small furry scientist is watching it.

shots.prompt: a cute chubby orange tabby cat with big green eyes and a mischievous grin, sitting on a wooden table staring at a cup of coffee at the table edge, cozy kitchen, close up
close up of a cute chubby orange tabby cat with big green eyes and a mischievous grin eyes slowly narrowing, comedic suspense

scenes.narration: Why do they do it? Scientists say cats are natural hunters, and a paw tap is how a cat tests whether something is alive, edible, or just annoying.

shots.prompt: a cute chubby orange tabby cat with big green eyes and a mischievous grin, gently tapping a toy mouse with one paw, curious face, cozy living room
a cute chubby orange tabby cat with big green eyes and a mischievous grin, poking a cup with one paw, curious, comedic

scenes.narration: Objects that move are interesting to a cat. Objects that fall with a crash are even better, because that makes a sound, and sound is entertainment.

shots.prompt: a glass cup falling off a table in slow motion with sparkling water droplets, a cute chubby orange tabby cat with big green eyes and a mischievous grin watching amazed in the background
a cute chubby orange tabby cat with big green eyes and a mischievous grin, ears perked up with wide shocked delighted eyes, comedic

scenes.narration: There is another reason. When a cat knocks something over, the human reacts immediately. Cats quickly learn that a falling cup means instant attention.

shots.prompt: a surprised cartoon person in pajamas rushing into a kitchen, a cute chubby orange tabby cat with big green eyes and a mischievous grin sitting innocently on a counter
a cute chubby orange tabby cat with big green eyes and a mischievous grin, looking at the camera innocently, tiny halo above its head, comedic

scenes.narration: Cats also love a good routine. Many keep testing the very same spot, at the very same time, until the experiment has been confirmed.

shots.prompt: a cute chubby orange tabby cat with big green eyes and a mischievous grin, wearing tiny scientist goggles and a white lab coat, taking notes next to a glass of water, funny
a cute chubby orange tabby cat with big green eyes and a mischievous grin, pushing a pencil off a desk with a satisfied smile, cozy home office

scenes.narration: And did you know a cat's paws are packed with sensitive nerves? Every tap tells it about the weight, the texture, and the wobble of the world.

shots.prompt: extreme close up of a cute orange cat paw gently touching a shiny object, soft light, detailed fur
a cute chubby orange tabby cat with big green eyes and a mischievous grin, carefully pressing a paw on a wobbly jelly dessert, fascinated

scenes.narration: So the next time you catch your cat in the act, remember: it is not misbehaving. It is gathering data, and you are the data.
